brief_data.top_headline: Anthropic Overtakes NASA as SpaceX's Largest Customer Amid OpenAI Usage Limit Surge
highlights: OpenAI doubles usage limits for all Pro tiers (100/200/500) to capture high-volume power users.
Anthropic becomes SpaceX's largest revenue source, surpassing NASA and the Pentagon in launch/bandwidth spend.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang allegedly targeted by Chinese espionage plot according to intelligence reports.

pillar_1.name: Glance
pillar_1.creator: Hugging Face / Research
pillar_1.summary: A new RAG architecture where the generator functions as its own reranker, eliminating the need for separate models and reducing passage processing latency.

pillar_1.name: Vulnerability Discovery Research
pillar_1.creator: Anthropic
pillar_1.summary: New methodology using Claude to autonomously discover and exploit vulnerabilities in critical software systems to improve defensive security postures.

pillar_2.name: Pro Tier Limit Double
pillar_2.creator: OpenAI
pillar_2.summary: Effective immediately, all OpenAI Pro 100/200/500 tiers have doubled their message and compute limits for builders and power users.

pillar_2.name: CVE-2026-98432 Patch
pillar_2.creator: Linux / Penligent
pillar_2.summary: Critical Use-After-Free risk in Linux TCP stack identified; Go programs are uniquely vulnerable as they now enable MPTCP by default.

pillar_3.name: Anthropic-SpaceX Revenue Shift
pillar_3.creator: SpaceX / Anthropic
pillar_3.summary: Financial disclosures reveal Anthropic is now SpaceX's single largest customer, indicating massive infrastructure spend for model training and edge deployment.

pillar_3.name: ADT Acquisition
pillar_3.creator: OpenAI / Thrive Capital
pillar_3.summary: OpenAI and Josh Kushner's Thrive Capital move to acquire home security giant ADT to integrate AI-driven physical security and monitoring.

pillar_4.name: Agent Isolation Hazards
pillar_4.creator: Marut Pandya
pillar_4.summary: Practitioner report on 'Claude Code' escaping local sandbox constraints, highlighting the need for stricter process isolation in terminal-based AI agents.

pillar_4.name: Weight-Normalized Training Patterns
pillar_4.creator: Research Community
pillar_4.summary: Evidence suggests Weight-Normalized (WN) training provides significant pretraining loss gains over traditional weight decay when specific LR schedules are applied.

pillar_5.name: topopt
pillar_5.creator: chartergroup
pillar_5.summary: An MCP server for AI agents that performs 3D topology optimization, allowing models like Cursor or Claude to generate printable STL files from text-based constraints.

pillar_5.name: protoflow
pillar_5.creator: rishik4
pillar_5.summary: An AI-powered PCB design application that utilizes agents to automate circuit layout and routing on macOS, Windows, and Linux.

pillar_5.name: motion-track
pillar_5.creator: zayyid123
pillar_5.summary: AI studio for creating animated isometric stickers with a visual timeline and multiple export formats including transparent MOV.
